title: agrostis polymorpha var. capillaris
intro: Agrostis polymorpha var. capillaris, commonly known as a type of bent grass, is a perennial grass species. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis polymorpha var. capillaris include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, although further research is needed to confirm these constituents and their effects.
